blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Pretrained diffusion models provide powerful image priors for training-free posterior sampling in image restoration. To guide this sampling process, frequency-aware methods progressively incorporate measurement information across frequency bands, facilitating coarse-to-fine reconstruction.
However, existing methods typically do not explicitly separate frequency activation from degradation-induced attenuation, leaving attenuation differences among inactive frequencies insufficiently modeled.
In this work, we propose frequency-decoupled posterior guidance to separate frequency activation from attenuation-aware spectral regularization.
Specifically, a progressive low-to-high frequency schedule determines the active measurement band, while a kernel-derived attenuation map defines a selective spectral prior over inactive components.
To stabilize the sampling process, we also introduce a local trajectory regularizer that suppresses spatially irregular state-to-clean deviations.
For a fixed endpoint energy, we provide a KL-regularized path-space interpretation. In practice, we construct time-dependent guidance through local energy corrections using a Tweedie plug-in approximation. Experiments on natural-image benchmarks demonstrate strong PSNR and SSIM performance across challenging non-blind deblurring settings, even at higher measurement noise levels.

预先训练的传播模型为图像修复中无训练后取样提供了强大的图像前兆. 为了指导这一取样过程,频率感知方法逐步纳入跨频段的测量信息,为粗细重建提供方便.
然而,现行方法通常没有明确将频率活化与降解引起的衰减分开,使不活跃频率之间的衰减差异没有得到充分的模型化。
在这项工作中,我们提出频率分解后导线,将频率活化与衰减-知光谱正性分离.
具体来说,递进的低高频表决定了活性测量波段,而由内核衍生的衰减图则定义了选择性光谱的前于活性元件.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Image restoration aims to recover a clean image from incomplete or
corrupted measurements. A broad class of restoration tasks takes the form y = Ax 0 + n , n ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , σ y 2 ​ I m ) , \mathrm{y}=\mathrm{A}\mathrm{x}_{0}+\mathrm{n},\qquad\mathrm{n}\sim\mathcal{N}\bigl(\mathrm{0},\sigma_{\mathrm{y}}^{2}\mathrm{I}_{m}\bigr), (1) where x 0 ∈ ℝ d \mathrm{x}_{0}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} is the unknown image, y ∈ ℝ m \mathrm{y}\in\mathbb{R}^{m} is the observation, and A : ℝ d → ℝ m \mathrm{A}:\mathbb{R}^{d}\to\mathbb{R}^{m} is a known linear operator.
Recovering 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0} is generally ill-posed because operator A \mathrm{A} may attenuate or discard part of the image information. Effective restoration must therefore balance measurement fidelity with image priors.

Classical methods design the prior through handcrafted regularizers, while more recent approaches use learned denoisers or energy models ( Rudin et al., 1992 ; Cai et al., 2012 ; Glowinski et al., 2017 ; Su and Huang, 2026 ; Roth and Black, 2005 ; Venkatakrishnan et al., 2013 ; Dong et al., 2015 ) . Diffusion models provide an expressive alternative by learning the score fields of progressively perturbed data distributions ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Song et al., 2021 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) . Conditional diffusion models can learn a direct degraded-to-clean mapping, but typically require paired data and task-specific training ( Saharia et al., 2022 ; Whang et al., 2022 ) . Zero-shot methods instead combine a pretrained unconditional diffusion model with the known forward operator at inference time ( Kawar et al., 2022 ; Song et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Chung et al., 2023 ; Zhu et al., 2023 ) . This decoupling of the image prior from the observation model enables one pretrained model to address multiple inverse problems without retraining.

blocks.en: Despite this flexibility, existing zero-shot methods commonly enforce measurement consistency through spatial residuals, pseudoinverse projections, or likelihood gradients ( Kawar et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Chung et al., 2023 ; Meng and Kabashima, 2025 ) . For natural images, diffusion denoising often recovers coarse structure before fine detail ( Falck et al., 2025 ) . This behavior has motivated frequency-aware guidance, which progressively incorporates measurement information across frequency bands. FGPS follows this principle by gradually exposing measurement frequencies ( Thaker et al., 2025 ) ; noise-conditioned posterior continuation further couples frequency activation to the diffusion noise level ( Tian et al., 2026 ) . However, existing frequency-aware methods typically do not explicitly separate frequency activation from degradation-induced attenuation, leaving attenuation differences among inactive frequencies insufficiently modeled. This distinction matters for directional or frequency-selective blur, where frequencies at similar spatial scales can have substantially different responses.
blocks.zh: 尽管有这种灵活性,现有的零射出方法通常通过空间残基、伪反向预测或概率梯度强制执行测量一致性(Kawar等,2022;Wang等,2023;Chung等,2023;Meng和Kabashima,2025)。 对于自然图像,扩散去诺往往在细细细节之前恢复粗糙的结构(Falck等,2025.). 这种行为激发了对频率的认知引导,它逐渐融入了跨频段的测量信息. FGPS遵循了这一原则,逐渐暴露出测量频率(Thaker等,2025年;噪声条件后继再将夫妇频率活化到扩散噪声水平(Tian等,2026年). 然而,现有的频率感知方法通常没有明确地将频率活化与降解所引发的衰减区分开来,使得不活跃频率之间的衰减差异没有得到充分的建模。 这种区分对于方向性或频率选择性模糊很重要,在类似空间尺度的频率中,反应会大相径庭。

blocks.en:
Motivated by these observations, we propose frequency-decoupled posterior guidance for non-blind image deblurring. By decoupling frequency activation from attenuation-aware regularization, our approach enables more precise incorporation of measurement information, effectively preventing highly attenuated or noisy frequencies from corrupting the update direction. Meanwhile, it better models inactive components by preventing the diffusion prior from introducing hallucination artifacts in spectral regions where measurement data is absent or severely degraded.
Additionally, we introduce a local trajectory-stabilization regularizer that penalizes spatially irregular state-to-clean deviations, thereby promoting stable and spatially coherent sampling.
Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We introduce frequency-decoupled diffusion guidance for non-blind image deblurring. It is realized via a progressive schedule that determines which measurement frequencies are active at each reverse step, along with a kernel-derived attenuation map that defines a selective spectral prior over inactive components. • We formulate these components in a time-dependent guidance energy and derive practical stepwise corrections using a Tweedie plug-in approximation. To stabilize the updates, we introduce a local trajectory regularizer that suppresses spatially irregular state-to-clean deviations. For a fixed endpoint energy, we also provide a KL/Gibbs path-space interpretation. • We evaluate the proposed framework on natural-image benchmarks across challenging non-blind deblurring settings. The method achieves strong PSNR and SSIM performance and remains robust as measurement noise increases. Controlled ablations clarify the roles of the individual components and identify trajectory stabilization as a key contributor to the observed improvements.

blocks.en: 3 Related Work
blocks.zh: 3 相关工作

blocks.en: 3.1 Training-Based Diffusion Models for Image Restoration
blocks.zh: 3.1 图像修复培训传播模式

blocks.en: Conditional diffusion models learn restoration distributions from paired degraded and clean images. SR3 ( Saharia et al., 2023 ) conditions the reverse process on a low-resolution observation for image super-resolution, while Palette ( Saharia et al., 2022 ) extends conditional diffusion to a broader family of image-to-image tasks. I 2 SB ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , IR-SDE ( Luo et al., 2023 ) , and ResShift ( Yue et al., 2023 ) further incorporate the degradation process into the diffusion bridge or stochastic restoration dynamics. Their learned models or conditioning mechanisms are typically tied to the degradation distributions used in training.
blocks.zh: 有条件的传播模型从成对的已退化和清洁的图像中学习恢复分布. SR3(Saharia等,2023年)为图像超分辨率的低分辨率观测设定了反向过程的条件,而Palette(Saharia等,2022年)则有条件地向更广泛的图像到图像任务家族推广. I 2 SB (Liu等,2023年),IR-SDE (Luo等,2023年),ResShift (Yue等,2023年)进一步将降解过程融入了扩散桥或斯多克恢复动力学中. 他们学习的模型或调节机制通常与培训中使用的降解分布有关。

blocks.en: 3.2 Training-Free Diffusion Methods for Inverse Problems
blocks.zh: 3.2 反向问题的培训-免费传播方法

blocks.en: A common training-free strategy keeps the pretrained diffusion model fixed and uses the known forward operator to guide sampling.
blocks.zh: 一种通用的无培训战略使预先训练的传播模式固定下来,并使用已知的前方操作员指导取样。

blocks.en: Operator information and measurement guidance. DDRM ( Kawar et al., 2022 ) exploits the singular-vector structure of linear operators, while DDNM ( Wang et al., 2023 ) uses a range–null-space decomposition. DPS ( Chung et al., 2023 ) evaluates a likelihood surrogate at a denoised clean-image estimate; DMPS ( Meng and Kabashima, 2025 ) instead derives a closed-form likelihood-score approximation that avoids back-propagation through the denoiser.
blocks.zh: 运营商信息和计量指导. DDRM(Kawar等,2022年)利用了线性运算符的单向器结构,而DDNM(Wang等,2023年)则使用范围-null-space分解. DPS(Chung等,2023年)在去诺化的清洁成像估计中评价了一种可能性被取代;DMPS(Meng和Kabashima,2025年)取而代之的是闭式概率-分数相近,可以避免通过去诺化者反向传播.

blocks.en:
Frequency exposure and stabilization. A related line of work controls which frequency components are exposed to measurement consistency during sampling.
FGPS ( Thaker et al., 2025 ) progressively exposes measurement frequencies during
sampling.
Noise-conditioned posterior continuation ( Tian et al., 2026 ) combines frequency exposure
with a Haar-domain rule for committing coarse and detail corrections.
MASF ( Qian et al., 2024 ) stabilizes generation by averaging frequency components of
clean-image predictions across sampling steps.
Our method uses kernel-derived attenuation to weight a spectral prior over inactive frequencies and regularizes state-to-clean deviations locally.

Variational and reconstruction-oriented methods. Diffusion priors can also be incorporated into iterative reconstruction and explicit optimization objectives.
DiffPIR ( Zhu et al., 2023 ) combines diffusion denoising with plug-and-play restoration, while RED-Diff ( Mardani et al., 2024 ) uses variational approximation and denoising regularization. DMAP ( Xu et al., 2025 ) reinterprets DPS through posterior maximization and combines multiple likelihood-ascent steps with projection onto the reverse-transition Gaussian shell to improve reconstruction performance.

Output-space aggregation of multiple diffusion reconstructions has
previously been used to improve distortion-oriented restoration quality
in diffusion-based deblurring ( Whang et al., 2022 ; Ren et al., 2023 ) .
Different from these sample-averaging schemes, our final reconstruction
combines two independently completed branch-specific trajectories using a task-fixed output-space weight.

blocks.en:
We evaluate on Flickr-Faces-HQ (FFHQ) ( Karras et al., 2021 ) and the ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge 2012 (ILSVRC2012) validation set ( Deng et al., 2009 ; Russakovsky et al., 2015 ) , at 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution. For each dataset–task setting, we use a
fixed set of 1,000 1{,}000 evaluation images. Within each task, all methods receive identical degraded measurements for the same images. We use a pretrained unconditional diffusion model for FFHQ and a pretrained class-conditional model with ground-truth labels for ImageNet. The dataset-specific backbone is fixed across methods, without task-specific fine-tuning. Image preprocessing is detailed in Supplementary Sec. B .
Our code will be available at https://github.com/Sea-serpents/frequency-decoupled-diffusion-guidance .

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduced frequency-decoupled posterior guidance, a training-free framework that separates the diffusion-time activation of measurement frequencies from their reliability under the degradation operator. A progressive low-to-high schedule specifies the active measurement band, while a kernel-derived attenuation map weights the remaining inactive frequencies for spectral regularization. We provided a KL-regularized path-space interpretation of the fixed endpoint energy and derived practical stepwise guidance through a Tweedie plug-in approximation. Experiments on challenging non-blind deblurring tasks demonstrate consistent improvements in reconstruction fidelity and robustness to increased measurement noise. These results highlight the importance of jointly considering the evolving frequency content of reverse diffusion and the spectral properties of the degradation operator, and motivate further extensions to blind and nonlinear inverse problems as well as more efficient single-trajectory sampling.

blocks.en: B.1 Datasets and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: B.1 数据集和评价协议

blocks.en:
We evaluate on Flickr-Faces-HQ (FFHQ) ( Karras et al., 2021 ) and the
ILSVRC2012 validation set ( Deng et al., 2009 ; Russakovsky et al., 2015 ) at 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution. For each dataset–task setting, we use a
fixed set of 1,000 1{,}000 evaluation images. Within each task, all methods
receive the same degraded measurement of each image. Images are represented
in RGB. FFHQ images are resized to 256 × 256 256\times 256 when necessary; ImageNet
images are bicubically resized to 256 × 256 256\times 256 without cropping.

每个图像都得到同样的退化测量。 图片显示
在 RGB 中。 FFHQ 图像在必要情况下被调整为256×256256\times 256; ImageNet

blocks.en:
For FFHQ, we use the pretrained unconditional ffhq_10m.pt checkpoint distributed with the official DPS release ( Chung et al., 2023 ) .
For ImageNet, we use the pretrained 256 × 256 256\times 256 class-conditional
diffusion checkpoint released with Guided Diffusion ( Dhariwal and Nichol, 2021 ) ,
conditioning on the ground-truth class labels. The backbone is fixed
across methods within each dataset, without task-specific fine-tuning.

blocks.en: C.1 Complementary Perceptual Metrics
blocks.zh: C.1 补充概念计量

blocks.en:
Because our primary objective in non-blind image
inverse problems is faithful recovery of the specific image associated with each measurement, we first report PSNR and SSIM in the main text. The complementary LPIPS and FID results are reported in Table 5 .
The results reveal a clear separation between paired fidelity and perceptual
quality. Although DPS-MAP and DMPS are among the strongest baselines in PSNR
and SSIM, their LPIPS and FID values are frequently worse than those of FGPS
and DSG, particularly on FFHQ. The main exception is ImageNet motion
deblurring, where DPS-MAP achieves the best LPIPS and the second-best FID;
DMPS also obtains a competitive LPIPS in this setting, although its FID
remains high. Overall, FGPS achieves the best FID in all six settings and the
best LPIPS in five of them, while DSG is generally the next strongest
perceptual baseline. Our method does not dominate these perceptual metrics:
its results often lie between the perception-oriented baselines and the
strong distortion-oriented solvers, consistent with its emphasis on
measurement-faithful recovery. These observations motivate reporting LPIPS
and FID alongside, rather than in place of, the paired PSNR and SSIM results.
